source_refs.note: Exercise 14.4 Q2, book p.289 (PDF 294). No answer in the key (verification); all three products = 117 (sympy). Solution book PDF 1269-1270 agrees.

blocks.explanation:
Yeh verify karne (tasdeeq) ka sawal hai: scalar triple product ki cyclic property ko numbers se check karna hai.
Diya kya hai? Teen vectors \(\underline{a}, \underline{b}, \underline{c}\).
Find kya karna hai? Teeno products alag alag nikal kar dikhana ke teeno barabar hain.
Rule kaunsa? Pehle cross product (determinant se), phir dot product. Cross hamesha pehle hota hai.
Plan: \(\underline{b} \times \underline{c}\), \(\underline{c} \times \underline{a}\), \(\underline{a} \times \underline{b}\) nikal kar har ek ko baqi bache vector se dot karenge.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(\underline{a} = 3\underline{i} - \underline{j} + 5\underline{k}\), \(\underline{b} = 4\underline{i} + 3\underline{j} - 2\underline{k}\), \(\underline{c} = 2\underline{i} + 5\underline{j} + \underline{k}\).
Humein verify karna hai: \(\underline{a} \cdot (\underline{b} \times \underline{c}) = \underline{b} \cdot (\underline{c} \times \underline{a}) = \underline{c} \cdot (\underline{a} \times \underline{b})\).
Tareeqa: \(\underline{a} \cdot \underline{b} \times \underline{c}\) ka matlab \(\underline{a} \cdot (\underline{b} \times \underline{c})\) hi hai. Kyun? Agar pehle dot karein to \(\underline{a} \cdot \underline{b}\) ek number ban jata hai, aur number ka kisi vector ke saath cross product hota hi nahi. Is liye brackets na bhi likhe hon, cross pehle hi hoga. Har cross product determinant formula se nikalenge.

Pehla product: \(\underline{b} \times \underline{c}\)
\[\underline{b} \times \underline{c} = \begin{vmatrix} \underline{i} & \underline{j} & \underline{k} \\ 4 & 3 & -2 \\ 2 & 5 & 1 \end{vmatrix}\]
\[= (3 + 10)\underline{i} - (4 + 4)\underline{j} + (20 - 6)\underline{k}\]
\[= 13\underline{i} - 8\underline{j} + 14\underline{k}\]
\[\underline{a} \cdot (\underline{b} \times \underline{c}) = 39 + 8 + 70 = 117\]
Kyun: \(\underline{i}\) ka minor \((3)(1) - (-2)(5) = 3 + 10\); \(\underline{j}\) ka minor \((4)(1) - (-2)(2) = 4 + 4\), aur \(\underline{j}\) ke saath minus sign lagta hai; \(\underline{k}\) ka minor \((4)(5) - (3)(2) = 20 - 6\). Phir dot product mein matching components multiply kar ke jama kiye: \((3)(13) + (-1)(-8) + (5)(14)\).
Dhyan dein: \(\underline{j}\) wali term ka minus sign bhoolna sab se aam ghalti hai.

Doosra product: \(\underline{c} \times \underline{a}\)
\[\underline{c} \times \underline{a} = \begin{vmatrix} \underline{i} & \underline{j} & \underline{k} \\ 2 & 5 & 1 \\ 3 & -1 & 5 \end{vmatrix}\]
\[= (25 + 1)\underline{i} - (10 - 3)\underline{j} + (-2 - 15)\underline{k}\]
\[= 26\underline{i} - 7\underline{j} - 17\underline{k}\]
\[\underline{b} \cdot (\underline{c} \times \underline{a}) = 104 - 21 + 34 = 117\]
Kyun: Yahan doosri row \(\underline{c}\) aur teesri row \(\underline{a}\) hai, kyunke product \(\underline{c} \times \underline{a}\) hai; tarteeb ulti karte to jawab ka sign ulta ho jata. Dot: \((4)(26) + (3)(-7) + (-2)(-17) = 104 - 21 + 34\).

Teesra product: \(\underline{a} \times \underline{b}\)
\[\underline{a} \times \underline{b} = \begin{vmatrix} \underline{i} & \underline{j} & \underline{k} \\ 3 & -1 & 5 \\ 4 & 3 & -2 \end{vmatrix}\]
\[= (2 - 15)\underline{i} - (-6 - 20)\underline{j} + (9 + 4)\underline{k}\]
\[= -13\underline{i} + 26\underline{j} + 13\underline{k}\]
\[\underline{c} \cdot (\underline{a} \times \underline{b}) = -26 + 130 + 13 = 117\]
Kyun: \(\underline{i}\) ka minor \((-1)(-2) - (5)(3) = 2 - 15\); \(\underline{j}\) ka minor \((3)(-2) - (5)(4) = -26\), aur minus sign ke saath \(+26\); \(\underline{k}\) ka minor \((3)(3) - (-1)(4) = 9 + 4\). Dot: \((2)(-13) + (5)(26) + (1)(13)\).

Muqabla aur tasdeeq
\[117 = 117 = 117 \;\checkmark\]
\[\begin{vmatrix} 3 & -1 & 5 \\ 4 & 3 & -2 \\ 2 & 5 & 1 \end{vmatrix} = 117\]
Kyun: Teeno barabar aaye, jaisa cyclic property kehti hai: \(\underline{a} \to \underline{b} \to \underline{c} \to \underline{a}\) ke daire mein aage khiskane se value nahi badalti. Ek hi determinant \([\underline{a}\ \underline{b}\ \underline{c}]\) bhi 117 deta hai, yeh mazeed tasdeeq hai. Exam mein yeh property yaad rakhein, kaam bohat bachata hai.
blocks.final_answer: Teeno products \(117\) hain. Saabit ho gaya: \(\underline{a} \cdot \underline{b} \times \underline{c} = \underline{b} \cdot \underline{c} \times \underline{a} = \underline{c} \cdot \underline{a} \times \underline{b} = 117\).
